// @path: src/app/ops/gallery/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-MEDIA-ELEMENT
// next/image was doubly invisible: "next/" is on the package prefix allowlist,
// so the import rule waved it through and there was no media rule at all.
import Image from "next/image";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { latest } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

export default async function OpsGallery() {
  await requireOperator();
  const p = await latest();
  return <Image src={p.path} width={200} height={200} alt="" />;
}
